column1: # Eleven queries to take the collection from 39 to 50, the TREC convention.
# Written on 2026-10-12 to fill topic areas the existing 39 do not cover.
# None of them has been run through either retrieval system, so no query here
# was chosen by how the stemmer performs on it.
# Each was checked against the 44,814-document collection before being kept:
# a query was rejected if fewer than 15 documents contain all of its content
# words (nothing to judge) or if more than 45% of the collection contains any
# of them (matches everything, as q003 does). The "docs" column records how
# many documents contain every content word.
